42829-in-quest-of-gold-or-under-the-whan.title: _Under the Whanga Falls_.
42829-in-quest-of-gold-or-under-the-whan.creator: Unknown
42829-in-quest-of-gold-or-under-the-whan.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Alec, Alec," a strong, clear, boy's voice rang out from the gully, "are you up there? Whatever are you doing at this time of night?" And the next moment George Law, a tall, strongly made lad of fifteen or so, left the sandy bed of the dried-up river, and sprang up the great rocks, as lightly and actively as a cat, to where his elder brother was sitting alone.

arxiv-1703-03019.title: Macroscopically constrained Wang-Landau method for systems with multiple order parameters and its application to drawing complex phase diagrams
arxiv-1703-03019.creator: C. H. Chan 1, G. Brown 1,2, P. A. Rikvold 1
arxiv-1703-03019.description: Abstract A generalized approach to Wang-Landau simulations, macroscopically constrained Wang-Landau, is proposed to simulate the density of states of a system with multiple macroscopic order parameters. The method breaks a multidimensional random-walk process in phase space into many separate, one-dimensional random-walk processes in well-defined subspaces.

arxiv-2001-10248.description: Abstract . In the modern Web, service providers often rely heavily on third parties to run their services. arxiv-2212-13360.title: Extreme central L L -values of almost prime quadratic twists of elliptic curves Thanks: This work was supported by the National Key R&D Program of China (No. 2021YFA1000700) and NSFC (Nos. 12001314 and 12031008)
arxiv-2212-13360.creator: Shenghao Hua and Bingrong Huang
arxiv-2212-13360.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove the extreme values of L L -functions at the central point for almost prime quadratic twists of an elliptic curve. As an application, we get the extreme values for the Tate–Shafarevich groups in the quadratic twist family of an elliptic curve under the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 11F67, 11G05 1.

arxiv-2309-16326.title: Numerical schemes for a multi-species quantum BGK model Thanks: Received date, and accepted date (The correct dates will be entered by the editor).
arxiv-2309-16326.creator: Gi-Chan Bae, Marlies Pirner, Sandra Warnecke
arxiv-2309-16326.description: Abstract This work is devoted to the numerical implementation of the quantum Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) model for gas mixtures consisting of classical and quantum particles (fermions, bosons). We consider the model proposed by Bae, Klingenberg, Pirner, and Yun in 2021 and implement an Implicit-Explicit (IMEX) scheme due to the stiffness of the collision operator.

arxiv-2312-01289.title: Impact of density inhomogeneity on the critical velocity for vortex shedding in a harmonically trapped Bose-Einstein condensate
arxiv-2312-01289.creator: Haruya Kokubo, Kenichi Kasamatsu
arxiv-2312-01289.description: Abstract We report on a numerical study of the critical velocity for creation of quantized vortices by a moving Gaussian obstacle in a trapped Bose-Einstein condensate, modeled by the Gross-Pitaevskii equation. We pay attention to impact of density inhomogeneity associated with the global inverted-parabolic profile by a trapping potential as well as the local density suppression around the Gaussian obstacle.

arxiv-2506-14664.title: An advanced reliability reserve incentivizes flexibility investments while safeguarding the electricity market Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2506-14664.creator: Franziska Klaucke, Karsten Neuhoff, Alexander Roth, Wolf-Peter Schill, Leon Stolle
arxiv-2506-14664.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Franziska Klaucke, Karsten Neuhoff, Alexander Roth, Wolf-Peter Schill, Leon Stolle. To ensure security of supply in the power sector, many countries are already using or discussing the introduction of capacity mechanisms. Two main types of such mechanisms include capacity markets and capacity reserves. Simultaneously, the expansion of variable renewable energy sources increases the need for power sector flexibility, for which there are promising yet often under-utilized options on the demand side.

arxiv-2509-08860.title: USEANET: ULTRASOUND-SPECIFIC EDGE-AWARE MULTI-BRANCH NETWORK FOR LIGHTWEIGHT MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATION

arxiv-2512-03348.title: Forecasts for lifetime and fraction of Decaying Dark Matter based on redshift distortions from Euclid and BOSS.
arxiv-2512-03348.creator: Javier Juarez Jimenez 1 and Ana Avilez-López 1,2
arxiv-2512-03348.description: Abstract In this work we forecast constraints on models of decaying dark matter (DCDM) by using redshift-space-distortion (RSD) measurements implemented in a Fisher information matrix. In particular, we focus on the fraction of unstable dark matter, α dcdm \alpha_{\mathrm{dcdm}} respect to the ordinary CDM component, and the decay rate, Γ dcdm \Gamma_{\mathrm{dcdm}} as the key parameters of the model.

pmc-12630144.title: The specificity landscape of WRKY transcription factors reveals the bidirectional influence of non-CG methylation
pmc-12630144.creator: Nana Ma, Dingkun Jiang, Tian Li, Lin Luo, Hao Chen, Xinfeng Zhang, Zongkai Mu, Shuyan Chen, Piaojuan Chen, Qing Liu, Juncheng Lin, Qin Wang, Yimeng Yin, Jussi Taipale, Jing Huang, Honghong Guo, Fangjie Zhu
pmc-12630144.description: A distinct epigenetic feature of plants is the DNA methylation in non-CG contexts. Although the physiological roles of non-CG methylation have been elucidated, its direct impact on transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions remains largely unexplored. Focusing on WRKY-family TFs, here we investigated how non-CG methylation influences their DNA binding specificity and genome-wide cis-regulatory elements (CREs).

pmc-12636270.title: Stereoselective Synthesis of Alkenyl Fluorides and Alkynes by Defluoro Coupling of Trifluoromethyl Arenes
pmc-12636270.creator: José L. Rosario‐Collazo, Courtney Westlund, Hawa Keita, Simon J. Meek
pmc-12636270.description: A practical method for the stereoselective synthesis of tri‐ and tetra‐substituted 1,2‐fluoro‐borylalkenes and alkynes by defluoro / C–C coupling of aryl trifluoromethyl groups is disclosed. Transformations convert simple abundant CF3–arenes and multifunctional organodiboron reagents in the presence of a Lewis base activator into coupled products in up to 94% yield and >98:2 Z/E selectivity.

pmc-12722719.title: MTAKD: multi-teacher agreement knowledge distillation for edge AI skin disease diagnosis
pmc-12722719.creator: Andreas Winata, Nur Afny Catur Andryani, Alexander Agung Santoso Gunawan, Ford Lumban Gaol, Tokuro Matsuo
pmc-12722719.description: Skin disease diagnosis remains challenging in remote areas due to limited access to dermatology specialists and unreliable internet connectivity. Edge AI offers a potential solution by offloading the inference process from cloud servers to mobile devices. This research proposes a novel Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation (MTAKD) framework to optimize small model performance for mobile edge deployment.

pmc-12757346.title: Case Report: A case of Culler-Jones syndrome caused by GLI2 gene mutation
pmc-12757346.creator: Xiaomei Xie, Youfen Wei, Ye Li, Junyan Wang, Yating Zhang, Jie Wu, Fan Wang
pmc-12757346.description: Culler-Jones syndrome (CJS) (OMIM: 615849) is a rare genetic condition characterized by considerable phenotypic variability. This case reports a 5-day-old male neonate who presented with postaxial polydactyly, growth restriction, and recurrent epileptic seizures. A thorough clinical workup, including laboratory investigations, imaging, and genetic analysis, resulted in a confirmed diagnosis of Culler-Jones syndrome.

pmc-13187029.title: Osteoblast-derived CAR3 synergizing with collagen and bone sialoprotein enhances bone formation
pmc-13187029.creator: Xiaoxin Ma, Qing He, Chen Ye, Jinglun Zhang, Xinyi Zhou, Yuxuan Zhang, Tian Gan, Zhe Li, Fangfang Song, Yufeng Zhang
pmc-13187029.description: Osteoblasts orchestrate the infiltration and crystallization of mineral precursors within collagen fibrils. Certain osteoblast-secreted mineralization-inducing proteins further stimulate bone formation. In this study, scRNA-seq analysis of murine skull and long bone revealed a striking expression pattern of carbonic anhydrase III (Car3) in osteoblasts.

pmc-13199813.title: Persistent sciatic artery identified during prostatic artery embolization
pmc-13199813.creator: Brayden Bagla, Amiya Bagla, Sandeep Bagla, Michael Hoss
pmc-13199813.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A persistent sciatic artery (PSA) is a rare congenital vascular anomaly that may complicate endovascular pelvic procedures. We report a case of PSA incidentally identified during prostatic artery embolization in a patient with symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia. Angiography revealed a dominant PSA continuing from the common iliac artery through the sciatic notch, supplying the gluteal branches and internal pudendal artery, with hypoplasia of the superficial femoral artery. The ipsilateral prostatic artery originated from the internal pudendal branch of the PSA.

pmc-13224236.title: Quality of life and outcomes of patients operated on for glioblastoma
pmc-13224236.creator: Haman Nassourou Oumarou, Foka Tacsing Bolivers Kahn, Anu Ronaldo Fonju, Ghislain Guea Ngbwa, Djientcheu Vincent De Paul
pmc-13224236.description: Background: Glioblastoma is the most common and aggressive primary malignant brain tumor in adults, with a poor prognosis despite multimodal treatment. This study aimed to describe the diagnostic aspects, therapeutic strategies, quality of life (QoL), and outcomes of patients operated on for glioblastoma at the Yaoundé General Hospital.Methods: This was a retrospective cohort study conducted at the Yaoundé General Hospital.
